notes: The Forest core scene registry is exported for all levels 1-100.
Authored world facts, choices, encounter routing, encounter presentation kernels and late-world structures are exported as separate runtime registries.
Ordinary core levels reuse shared procedural Story generation instead of per-level implementations.
TBD weights, final dialogue, effects and exact mechanics remain explicit and are never inferred by runtime export.
Levels requiring relationship synthesis, authored revisit, world synthesis or elemental manifestation remain non-executable until their generic primitives exist.
Relation runtime accepts only explicitly exported authored ID pairs; no semantic inference is allowed.
